authority: docs/OWNER_SPEC.md OWNER v2.0 and OWNER endpoint/warmup/hygiene amendment 2026-11-16
economicHypothesis: Volatility clustering and state-dependent continuation/reversion imply that the local conditional distribution of subsequent four fully observed H1 bars can contain incremental information beyond constant-drift, unconditional recent historical distribution and simple own-price momentum. Neighbor similarity on completed-bar impulse/volatility/location plus as-of cross-market USD pressure will predict a useful next-4h amplitude and risk distribution only if compared at matching endpoint clocks. This is to be falsified; no prior claim of alpha.
novelty: One predeclared rolling analog distribution learner per instrument, with continuous features and as-of endpoint-specific matured training labels. Not the closed HSD1 48 static family gates, SPDE1 categorical cells, MVE1 linear ridge, HXP1 deterministic lagged-peer signal or RDE1 risk workflow.

timeline.withinSelectionPrequentialUpdate: Allowed ONLY labels that mature strictly BEFORE current endpoint minus one completed H1; no refitting hyperparameters to selection scores.

endpoint.resolution: All completed source H1 bars at each UTC timestamp, including within exchange sessions; no hard-coded 3 or 6 daily decision hours
endpoint.peerObservation: Other EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD completed at exact UTC T; if absent use peerMissing indicator; never forward-fill peer price
endpoint.label: entry proxy next H1 OPEN at T; exit proxy fourth consecutive H1 CLOSE T+4h; future high/low observed only for scoring and distribution training after full maturity

warmup.feature: 41 observed completed H1 bars incl T; >=24 genuine adjacent within-session 1h returns in previous40; latest4 contiguous impulse
warmup.modelUpdates: Pure replay from matured prior historical neighbor examples; no batch fitting to future and no forward-leaked global scaling
warmup.labelMaturity: Four-hour outcome plus one completed H1 embargo; label never visible to model on or before maturity.
warmup.evaluation: Keep 26/13/13 training/selection/exposed partitions; no outcome crossing phase may certify selection, exact ISO-week block uncertainty

hygiene.periodicInformationHygiene: Rolling 13-week time window expires past analogs mechanically, irrespective of their profit or loss; exponential half-life 4 weeks fixed before scoring; no regime-adaptive ex-post sample pruning
hygiene.dateProvenance: Every feature carries own completed-H1 source clock; every label carries later maturity clock; training candidate included only after strictly matured

fullDistance: L2 distance with frozen weights (1.0,0.75,0.75,0.5,0.5,1.0), normalized feature clipped +-5, missing peer encoded as zero plus explicit missing flag; no look-ahead scaling
ownOnlyDistance: L2 of only own impulse, trend, volatility and channel, same analog universe and k

model.method: Past-only same-symbol nearest historic endpoint analog distribution
model.meanShrinkage: Fixed 32 pseudo-examples at unconditional past-only matured-label mean
model.probUpPrior: Beta(1,1) on recency-weighted neighbor signs; no data from current endpoint outcome
model.futureDispersion: weighted 10th and 90th percentiles of neighbor normalized returns, model residual SE and realized favorable/adverse historical excursion
model.labelTreatment: All matured y used in their observed magnitude (no filtering or hindsight winner pruning); analog weights and prior strength fixed pre-score.

controls: unconditional last13week mature-label mean at same endpoint
simple prior4h continuation scaled by 0.25 fixed

validation.weeklyBlock: ISO-week, include zero or missing observations explicitly
validation.matchedComparisons: Identical feature-eligible and future-labelled endpoint clocks; no instrument cherry-pick
validation.trainOnlySelectionRules: All hyperparameters frozen pre-source; do not select trained variants by retrospective outcome. Primary full model must beat own-only and unconditional on selection weekly paired lower 95% difference and improvement versus fixed momentum.
validation.selectionCriticalT: 2.5 for paired 13-week score differences as conservative multiple comparator control
validation.selectionPolicy: Only full model; choose direction from current conditional expected EUR payoff, min60% calibrated neighbor direction probability, estimated commission-only EUR mean minus 2.0*SE greater than current observed tariff commission floor; abstain otherwise; no funded execution

economics.conversion: For economics of realized H1 price proxy convert USD quote proceeds at contemporaneous H1 EURUSD CLOSE at exit (and USDJPY at exit for JPY quote); estimated ex-ante signal uses EURUSD and USDJPY completed closes AS-OF T only
economics.currentTariffLookaheadWarning: 2026-11-04 current tariff is an EX-POST HYPOTHETICAL COST SCENARIO for old endpoints, not a historically available cost input. Therefore even simulated gating is not fully as-of-causal historical trading policy until contemporaneous tariff data exist.

marketStateAtEndpoint.state: 2 binary flags describing completed-H1 historical state, highVolatility from log(sigma8/sigma24) > ln(1.25), strongTrend from abs(normalized own 12-observation price trend) >1.25; 4 labels 0..3. These states are causal descriptive context; never separately optimized or selected as a 48-cell grid.
marketStateAtEndpoint.source: already frozen continuous own feature vector; no extra market query
